_meta.trust_law: Land Agents Act 1994 (SA); strata manager contract dependent

max_interest_rate_pa.notes: Interest on unpaid contributions is capped by regulation; public guidance commonly references 15% per annum.

interest_grace_period_days.notes: No grace period encoded; due date and interest treatment must follow the approved contribution resolution.

trial_balance_deadline_days.notes: Operational default for managed schemes; confirm against manager licence and contract.

min_withholding_pct_no_abn.notes: ATO PAYG withholding: 47% on payments to suppliers without ABN.

agm_notice_days.notes: Meeting notice control used as conservative workflow default; scheme articles and legal review remain authoritative.

capital_funding_standard_notice_days.notes: No verified generic capital-funding levy payment period is encoded. The approved contribution resolution must state contribution basis and due terms.

capital_funding_emergency_notice_days.notes: No shorter generic emergency period is encoded.

capital_funding_notice_period_verified.notes: Payment-period validation must rely on legal-review evidence and approved motion text, not a generic platform default.

capital_funding_resolution_required.notes: Contributions are usually fixed by ordinary resolution; an alternative non-unit-entitlement basis requires unanimous resolution.

capital_funding_allocation_basis.notes: Default contribution allocation is unit entitlement unless a unanimous resolution approves another basis.

capital_funding_benefit_principle_availa.notes: No generic benefit-principle allocator is enabled; alternative allocation requires unanimous approval and legal review.

capital_funding_tenant_consultation_requ.notes: Tenant consultation is not a default contribution-approval condition.

capital_funding_hardship_notice_required.notes: No SA-specific hardship notice requirement is encoded; hardship workflows should remain available by policy.

capital_funding_hybrid_legal_review_requ.notes: Hybrid owner-funded and loan-funded structures require recorded legal approval before notices or credits are issued.
